sectionDescriptions.Weekend Attendance: As summer has come to a close, we have seen our attendance bounce back to higher than ever before this time of year. We expect record numbers, and encourage anyone reading this to please attend the 8am service if you are able to make room at the others for guests!
sectionDescriptions.Baptisms: Baptisms trending toward another record year!
sectionDescriptions.Church Members: Member dates prior to 2024 are estimates. New process saw massive influx in 2025, and we're trending for a record 2026 so far!
sectionDescriptions.Serve Teams: Where we most need volunteers right now — full teams are healthy, gaps are invitations.
sectionDescriptions.Average Giving by Month: We think the August dip had a lot to do with uncertainty and diversion of funds because of the fires in and around our city. Need line is what we need on average to hit our [sign in to view] goal by May 2027. We're still well above our need line on average, August included.
sectionDescriptions.ALL-IN Pledge Progress: In May of 2026, we were ahead of schedule on our [sign in to view] goal, and when that increased to [sign in to view], we are now on track to overtake the goal again.
sectionDescriptions.Budget Allocation: Where every dollar given actually goes, including each church plant and mission we support.
sectionDescriptions.Community Groups: How many active community groups we have — the front door to real relationships.
sectionDescriptions.Community Group Members: How many people are doing life together in a community group.
